svg.text: INSTRUMENT PLATFORMS · EV CHARGING · INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION · LIFE-SCIENCE DATA · CONNECTED PRODUCT
discover capabilities · plan diagnostics · request captures · correlate across domains · evidence-linked reporting
UNIFORM CAPABILITY CONTRACT · EVERY NODE AND EVERY DOMAIN SPEAKS IT
INSTRUMENT NODES · EACH ONE COMPLETE ON ITS OWN · ROSTER OPEN
DELIVERED DOMAINS · SAME CONTRACT, SAME TIMELINE, DIFFERENT BUYER
site limit is a hard constraint, not a target
the backend link will drop — what the charge point
does in that window separates a product from a demo
signed meter values where regulation requires them
the other 5.8 % is routed to a person on purpose
HTTP 200 with an error body still raises
same input, same output, byte-equal, six months later
a dropped record raises — it never just logs
a node is a target only if inhibiting it moves the phenotype
15 claims tracked · 4 pass the gate · 11 open, with
the reason each one is open written down
negative results stored beside positive ones
BLE provisioning · OTA with tested rollback
offline for a week is not healthy and not failed —
it is unknown, and the dashboard has to say so
provisioning fails in a room with forty devices,
ONE TIMESTAMP DOMAIN · ONE EVIDENCE MODEL · SHA-256 OVER RAW BYTES
RUST · C / C++ · PYTHON · TYPESCRIPT · VHDL / VERILOG · KOTLIN · SWIFT · DART — CHOSEN PER LAYER, NOT PER PREFERENCE
RECEIVE-ONLY BY DEFAULT ON ANY LIVE BUS · PER-CHANNEL TX GATING · MEASURED BEFORE CLAIMED · EVERY RESULT RE-DERIVABLE FROM STORED BYTES
